comparison.objective: Raise a floating tag in a narrow tube by water displacement, then retrieve it.
comparison.physical_skill: Select sinking slugs, insert three into the tube, and lift the raised float/tag into a tray.
comparison.success_condition: Three sinking slugs raise the tag above the rim; cork-only and direct-reaching shortcuts score zero.
comparison.reason: This tests causal displacement and repeated object insertion, not mechanical setting, locking, or dynamic-response tuning.
